headline: Why we run OCR on the phone, not on a server.
voice: Why we run OCR on the phone, not on a server. Shoppers did not want to upload photos of everyday products. So the photo never leaves the device.

label: Halal Code Check
headline: The label is read on the phone.

label: Product engineering
headline: Slower than a server. Fast enough for an aisle.
voice: On-device OCR is slower than a cloud service. Multi-pass recognition, early exit and compression brought a scan down from minutes to under a minute. That is inside the time a shopper spends in an aisle.

label: Product engineering
headline: Privacy can be an architecture choice, not a policy page.
body: If the data never leaves the phone, you do not need to ask people to trust you with it.
